correctness.rationale: Inspected two complete standard-library source scripts. Independent exhaustive perfect-matching enumeration found exactly 120 matchings, feasible even complementary factors yield 504 distinct NAMED colorings. Enumerated every bichromatic cycle switch and verified reciprocity, 1674 undirected switching edges and exactly 144/360 components. All-source BFS recomputed small-sector shells (1,6,27,66,44), edge count432, diameter4 and large-sector degree counts 6:210,8:144,12:6, distances (1242,5904,18981,31401,6732,360), ecc 5:330 and 6:30; cycle-type 10+14 exactly small sector. Verified explicit shift/reflection/alpha preserve base graph, generated 144-element group, regular 144-colouring orbit and all six neighbouring generators are involutions. Exact finite exploration exhausts the defined graph, not an infinite family.
residual_risks: Results apply only to GP(12,5), not a uniform generalized Petersen family.
Coloured states remain distinct under palette permutations; a 84-state unlabeled count must not be substituted for the named graph.

value.rationale: A complete metric and group-action classification of a natural 24-vertex symmetric cubic graph’s edge-Kempe state space reveals a sharp Cayley-versus-irregular sector dichotomy, marked by an invariant bichromatic 10-cycle and different girth/eccentricity. These structural invariants can serve exact reconfiguration benchmarks beyond the previously tabulated class count.
residual_risks: One finite graph only; utility is as a complete natural benchmark and symmetry phenomenon, not a general theorem.
